For mothers, parents, family caregivers, and verified maternal-child health experts who need a safer and more organized way to manage pregnancy, postpartum recovery, baby care, and early childhood support, CareBridge is a community-based maternal and early childhood healthcare support platform that provides care journey tracking, personal health record storage, reminders, baby care journals, moderated Q\&A, verified content, family coordination, AI-assisted risk triage, and expert connection.

Unlike fragmented paper records, phone galleries, messaging applications, public social media groups, and standalone pregnancy or baby tracking applications, CareBridge brings essential care-support activities into one structured and privacy-controlled platform. Users can manage important care information, ask sensitive questions in a safer community, receive reminders, prepare better information before expert consultation, and share selected data with family members or experts based on clear permissions.

The vision of CareBridge is to help families feel less confused, less isolated, and better prepared during the maternal and early childhood care journey. When the product is used effectively, mothers and caregivers will no longer need to depend mainly on scattered notes, informal advice, or uncontrolled online communities. Instead, they will have a trusted digital support layer that helps them understand what to do next, when to seek expert support, and how to coordinate care with family members more safely.

### **5.2 Product Value for Key Stakeholders** {#5.2-product-value-for-key-stakeholders}

CareBridge is designed to balance the needs of multiple stakeholder groups.

For mothers, pregnant women, and postpartum users, the system provides a simple way to follow their care journey, store personal records, receive reminders, access verified content, ask sensitive questions with privacy control, and connect with experts when needed.

For parents of infants and young children, the system supports baby care journals, vaccination reminders, growth tracking, development notes, symptom records, and care summaries that can be used when asking experts or visiting healthcare facilities.

For spouses, grandparents, and other family caregivers, CareBridge enables cooperative care through shared schedules, selected reminders, baby care tasks, and important alerts. This helps reduce the burden on the mother while still protecting sensitive health information through permission-based access.

For verified experts, the platform provides a trusted channel to answer selected community questions, contribute reviewed content, build professional reputation, and provide private consultation when appropriate. Experts are not positioned as replacing hospitals or direct medical examination, but as verified supporters within a safe digital care ecosystem.

For the developing organization, CareBridge creates a realistic foundation for a social-impact startup. The product can begin with free core features to attract users and demonstrate social value, then gradually develop sustainable revenue through optional expert consultation, premium utilities, CSR programs, and collaboration with healthcare-related organizations without selling personal health data.

### **5.3 Product Direction and Practical Constraints** {#5.3-product-direction-and-practical-constraints}

CareBridge’s vision is idealistic but must remain realistic for a capstone project and early-stage product. The system should first focus on practical, high-value functions such as user accounts, care journey setup, mother and baby profiles, reminders, personal health records, baby journals, moderated community Q\&A, verified expert profiles, verified content, basic report handling, and safe AI-assisted intake.

The product does not aim to become a hospital information system, official electronic medical record system, emergency service, diagnosis tool, prescription platform, or full online medical examination platform. AI functions are limited to structured intake, symptom standardization, green/yellow/red risk triage, and safe next-action recommendations. Community answers must be treated as personal experiences, while expert answers must be clearly labeled according to professional verification status.

The initial deployment can focus on major cities such as Ha Noi, Hai Phong, and Ho Chi Minh City to validate real user demand, test moderation workflows, onboard verified experts, and improve the product model. After the system proves its effectiveness and operational stability, CareBridge can gradually expand to broader provincial markets and healthcare-related professional networks.

In the long term, CareBridge aims to become a trusted digital support ecosystem for maternal and early childhood care. Its success should be measured not only by user growth, but also by safer information sharing, better family coordination, stronger expert participation, responsible data protection, and the ability to reduce users’ dependence on fragmented records and uncontrolled online health communities.

## **6\. Project Scope & Limitations** {#6.-project-scope-&-limitations}

| Code | Feature Name | Description |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| MF-01 | Account, Trust & Access Control | Provides account lifecycle, separate community identity, role-based access, notification preferences, session protection, consent management, expert trust review and sensitive access auditing. Public community identity remains separate from private maternal and child data. |
| MF-02 | Mother Care Journey | Supports users throughout the preconception, pregnancy, and postpartum recovery stages through journey initialization, pregnancy week tracking, reproductive health care planning, maternal health indicator management, health record management, recovery logs, creation and management of reminders for appointments, medications, vitamins, and health care tasks, as well as reviewed pregnancy exercise support.  |
| MF-03 | Baby Care Journey, Growth & Vaccination | Supports baby profiles, feeding/sleep/diaper journals, development milestones, growth measurements, user-entered child health records and protected attachments, and vaccination records. It supports observation and appointment preparation, not diagnosis or pediatric assessment. |
| MF-04 | Community Q\&A & Moderation | Provides topic-based and optionally anonymous questions, community answers, verified expert answer labels, reports, moderation and topic governance. Search, filter, sorting and pagination are embedded in their owning feed, list and detail screens rather than treated as standalone use cases. |
| MF-05 | Verified Expert Network & Contribution | Manages expert profiles, credential review, specialty/service scope, availability, directory visibility and expert contribution. Contribution points indicate participation only and do not represent clinical competence or medical accuracy. |
| MF-06 | AI Nurse Assistant & Risk Triage | Collects structured symptom context and returns non-diagnostic green/yellow/red risk orientation with safe next-step guidance using approved knowledge and red-flag rules. It must not diagnose disease, prescribe medication or make clinical decisions. |
| MF-07 | Emergency Map & Nearby Care Support | Provides emergency-map entry, nearby care facilities, route/ETA and quick call/navigation. It supports faster action but does not dispatch ambulances or guarantee expert arrival. |
| MF-08 | Family Sync & Cooperative Care | Supports care groups, family invitations, scoped permissions and shared calendar/data/alerts. Family members only access information within the granted permission scope. |
| MF-09 | Verified Content & Checklist Hub | Provides reviewed stage-based articles, FAQs and actionable checklists with source labels, review status, versioning and content governance so outdated or unsafe material can be corrected or removed. |
| MF-10 | Smart Activity Monitoring & Safety Support | Uses phone accelerometer and gyroscope data only after consent to detect suspected falls/impacts, request safety confirmation, alert selected contacts and record false-positive feedback. It is not a certified fall detector or emergency dispatch system. |
| MF-11 | Connected Device & Health Data Integration | Version 2 \- Deferred. Future scope for opt-in device/platform connection or controlled manual import, source and quality labels, trend viewing, disconnection and imported-data deletion. No active Release 1 use case, screen or integration is retained. |
| MF-12 | Paid Direct Consultation & Commission | Version 2 \- Deferred. Future scope for booking, payment, realtime text/voice/video sessions, temporary record sharing, commission, disputes and refunds. No active Release 1 use case, screen or integration is retained. |
| CC-01 | Safety, Compliance & Abuse Prevention | Cross-cutting control, not an independent user feature. Applies mandatory disclaimers, dangerous-advice blocking, privacy/consent enforcement, audit logging, expert-access restrictions, location/device safeguards and abuse-prevention rules across all relevant functions. |

### **6.3 Limitations & Exclusions** {#6.3-limitations-&-exclusions}

| Code | Limitation / Exclusion | Description |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| LI-01 | Not a Medical Examination or Treatment Platform | CareBridge is a community-driven maternal and early childhood health support platform. It does not provide official medical examination, diagnosis, treatment, prescription, clinical procedures or emergency medical services. |
| LI-02 | No Disease, Injury or Pregnancy-Complication Diagnosis | The system shall not diagnose diseases, pregnancy complications, postpartum conditions, child illnesses, injuries, developmental disorders or exercise-related medical conditions. AI output, expert guidance, sensor events, growth trends and device data provide initial support only. |
| LI-03 | No Prescription or Dosage Recommendation | CareBridge shall not prescribe medicines, recommend specific drugs, determine dosages, change prescriptions, stop medication or replace instructions issued by qualified healthcare professionals. |
| LI-04 | No Replacement for Emergency Services | Red-flag guidance, emergency maps, quick calls, location alerts, suspected-fall alerts and family notifications only support faster action. CareBridge does not dispatch ambulances, automatically contact emergency teams or guarantee that medical assistance will arrive. |
| LI-05 | No Full HIS or Official EMR Functionality | CareBridge shall not operate as a Hospital Information System or official Electronic Medical Record platform. Inpatient care, hospital beds, clinical orders, insurance claims, laboratory workflows, pharmacy workflows and official medical records are outside the scope. |
| LI-06 | No Clinic-Centered Internal Operation | Doctor shifts, clinic rooms, hospital resource allocation, internal treatment workflows, hospital billing and full clinic administration are not included in the community-first product scope. |
| LI-07 | Community Advice Is Not Professional Medical Advice | Community posts and answers represent personal experience or emotional support. They shall not be treated as diagnosis, treatment, prescription, dosage advice or emergency instructions. |
| LI-08 | Moderation Reduces Risk but Cannot Eliminate All Unsafe Content | CareBridge provides reporting, pre/post-publication moderation, safety labels, warning rules and account restrictions, but it cannot guarantee that every harmful, misleading, abusive or commercially biased item will be detected or removed immediately. |
| LI-09 | Expert Verification Does Not Guarantee Accuracy or Outcomes | Verification confirms that a professional profile has passed platform-defined identity and credential checks. It does not guarantee that every answer is correct, that a professional is currently available or that digital support can replace direct examination. |
| LI-10 | AI Triage Is Not an Autonomous Medical Decision-Maker | The AI Nurse Assistant is limited to structured intake, information standardization, approved-content retrieval, risk orientation and safe next-step recommendations. It shall not act as an AI doctor, prescribe medication or make final clinical decisions. |
| LI-11 | AI Results Depend on Input and Configured Rules | AI intake and triage depend on user-provided information, approved knowledge and configured safety rules. Missing, vague, outdated or incorrect input may produce incomplete or inappropriate guidance. |
| LI-12 | Exercise and Posture Support Has Technical and Medical Limits | Pregnancy exercise support and pose feedback use approved low-risk content and predefined visible-landmark rules. They do not assess fetal condition, internal injury, pain causes or overall medical fitness. Poor lighting, camera angle, clothing, occlusion or device performance may reduce feedback quality. |
| LI-13 | User-Entered Records and Home Data Are Not Clinical-Grade Evidence | Symptoms, measurements, journals, milestones, vaccination notes, attachments and personal observations may be incomplete, outdated, incorrectly measured or incorrectly classified and shall not be treated as verified clinical evidence. |
| LI-14 | Growth and Vaccination Features Are References Only | Growth charts, milestones and vaccination schedules support tracking, preparation and reminders. They do not diagnose developmental disorders and do not replace official vaccination documentation, pediatric assessment or professional advice. |
| LI-15 | Privacy Controls Cannot Prevent External Re-Disclosure | CareBridge controls access within the platform but cannot prevent screenshots, copying, verbal disclosure or external misuse after information has been viewed. Anonymous display hides public identity from the community but not from internal moderation and accountability processes. |
| LI-16 | Internet, Notifications and Background Operation Are Not Guaranteed | Reminders, AI features, maps, location sharing, device synchronization, family alerts and IMU monitoring depend on internet access, permissions, operating-system restrictions, battery settings, sensors and third-party services. |
| LI-17 | Map, Nearby Care and Location Information May Be Inaccurate | Facility data, expert visibility, distance, route, ETA and current user location depend on third-party maps, GPS, network conditions, opt-in status and location-expiration settings. CareBridge cannot guarantee that a nearby resource is available or suitable. |
| LI-18 | Connected Device Data Is Not Clinical Measurement | Wearable and health-platform data may be delayed, incomplete, duplicated or inaccurate. It is used only for trend observation and consented contextual support and shall not replace medical-grade equipment or professional assessment. |
| LI-19 | Smart Activity Monitoring Cannot Guarantee Detection | Phone IMU monitoring may miss a real incident or create false alerts when the phone is dropped, not carried, switched off, permission-restricted, battery-depleted or blocked from background operation. A suspected event does not confirm injury or unconsciousness. |
| LI-20 | Safety Alerts and Nearby Support Do Not Guarantee Assistance | A user may request help or open emergency map support after a suspected event. CareBridge may notify selected contacts and show nearby resources according to consent, but it cannot guarantee that any recipient, expert or facility will respond or provide assistance. |
| LI-21 | Paid Consultation, Payment and Realtime Communication Are Version 2 Scope | Paid consultation booking, payment, commission, dispute/refund handling and realtime chat/voice/video sessions are deferred. They are not active Release 1 functions, screens or integrations. |
| LI-22 | Operation and Impact Dashboard Is Not in the Current Scope | Operation/impact dashboards, fundraising/CSR reporting and broad organizational analytics are not included in the current release. Only minimum audit and safety review needed for the implemented functions is retained. |
